statements.status_notes: Fixed in github.com/labstack/echo/v4 v4.16.3 (https://github.com/labstack/echo/releases/tag/v4.16.3; advisory https://github.com/labstack/echo/security/advisories/GHSA-246p-cpwv-v3jq). In v4.16.3 Context.RealIP() returns the connection peer address when Echo#IPExtractor is unset instead of trusting client-supplied X-Forwarded-For and X-Real-IP headers, so rotating forwarded-IP values cannot create fresh default rate-limit buckets. The temporal CLI binary in this image embeds echo/v4 v4.16.3 and does not contain the vulnerable pre-fix behavior.

Fixed in github.com/labstack/echo/v4 v4.16.3 (https://github.com/labstack/echo/releases/tag/v4.16.3; advisory https://github.com/labstack/echo/security/advisories/GHSA-99jh-6h7p-pp36). In v4.16.3 the Proxy middleware derives the upstream X-Real-IP header from Context.RealIP(), which uses the connection peer when Echo#IPExtractor is unset, so a client-supplied X-Real-IP is no longer forwarded. The temporal CLI binary in this image embeds echo/v4 v4.16.3 and does not contain the vulnerable pre-fix behavior.

Docker Scout reports no fixed github.com/labstack/echo/v4 release for this CVE; the latest v4 tag on the Go module proxy is v4.16.2 and remains within the affected range. debian-13 1.28.x through 1.32.x embed echo v4.16.1 in the locally built temporal CLI. Clearing the finding requires an upstream echo v4 security release or a coordinated major-line upgrade of the temporal CLI.
